ns2:course.label: Music in Higher Education
ns2:course.description: Provides an orientation to the organization, teaching and administration of music in the college or university. Includes topics such as preparing for and securing a college/university faculty position, promotion and tenure, faculty ethics and evaluation, and personnel/personal relations. Prerequisite: Graduate standing in music or music education.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Graduate standing in music or music education.
